title: Project kickoff meeting
content: The team agreed to build a project memory timeline that can answer questions from dated project records. The first prototype should use local data and preserve source dates.

title: Initial objective: searchable project memory
content: Objective v1: provide a searchable timeline for project decisions, meeting notes, and requirements. The first release should support local retrieval before any hosted storage is considered.

title: Specification v1: timeline record schema
content: Specification v1 requires records to include an identifier, title, content, record type, occurrence date, project identifier, version, source, and supersession reference. The prototype uses JSON files as its source.

title: Objective v2: offline-first evidence review
content: Objective v2 changes the priority to offline-first evidence review. A local prototype must explain which dated records support an answer and must not silently merge conflicting versions. Target review date: 2026-03-20.

title: Specification v2: cloud synchronization requirement
content: Specification v2 states that the first release must synchronize records to hosted object storage and expose cloud-backed retrieval by 2026-03-18. It does not explain whether this requirement overrides the offline-first objective.

title: Scope review meeting: unresolved delivery mode
content: The team noticed a conflict: Objective v2 prioritizes an offline-first local prototype, while Specification v2 requires cloud synchronization for the first release. The meeting recorded the conflict as unresolved and assigned no final decision.

title: Lifecycle snapshot: prototype retrieval validated
content: Lifecycle snapshot: the local JSON dataset and in-memory retrieval path were validated. Cloud synchronization was not implemented in this snapshot, and the objective/specification conflict remained open.

title: Objective v3: local RAG demonstration
content: Objective v3 narrows this demonstration to a local RAG prototype over synthetic records. It keeps the offline-first evidence-review priority and asks the assistant to state unresolved inconsistencies rather than resolve them automatically.
